text:
sai: idea: add a \"permission ripple\" visualizer in the console. you pick a role change and it shows downstream effects on routes, quota buckets, and which backends would be used.

ella: love that phrase. could be really helpful for support when customers ask why a tenant suddenly hits dedicated capacity.

ashley: UX question: should the visualizer be optimistic (assume change applied) or conservative (show both before/after)? i think a diff view is essential.

ben: implementation thought: we already snapshot policies at rollout time. run the visualizer against two snapshots: current and candidate. then render deltas. avoids touching live eval.

rahul: API-level debate: expose a simulate endpoint that takes {snapshot_id, principal, sample_req} and returns route_decision + quota_decision + cost_est. or make a higher-level compare endpoint that takes two snapshot ids and a principal and returns a diff report.

sai: both are useful. compare for UI diffs, simulate for SDKs and programmatic checks during CI/CD.

ella: telemetry: emit events with non-identifying hashes. e.g., event: `perm_ripple.run` attrs: mode=compare|simulate, snap_a, snap_b, principal_hash, sample_count. do not log full request bodies.

ashley: gating: only show visualizer to org admins and roles with `simulate:run`. for enterprise orgs enable candidate-snapshot creation in-console. for self-serve keep to read-only comparisons (no creating snapshots).

ben: rate-limits need to be tight. deep compare ops can be expensive if you ask for N=1000 sample requests. propose default cap 50, enterprise opt-in higher with billing flag.

rahul: security: visualizer should never cause side effects. make endpoints read-only and mark all sim runs as non-mutating in audit logs. still include a `sim_run_id` in audit stream so we can trace who ran it.

ops-bot: Note: file an RFC for api/simulate and include cost estimates for 50/200 sample runs.

sai: front-end: small pane beside role editor with live diff. quick-run uses precomputed route hints (fast, ~200ms), full-run queues a job and updates UI when ready.

ella: small export feature: csv of impacted routes and quota buckets per principal. useful for SRE handoffs.

ashley: accessibility: make sure the visual diff is also readable as text. heatmap -> table fallback.

ben: proto for API:
POST /v1/simulate/run
body: { snapshot_a: \"snap-111\", snapshot_b: \"snap-222\", principal: \"user:team-b\", sample: [{endpoint: \"/v1/generate\", seq_len: 512}], mode: \"compare\" }
resp: { run_id: \"r-987\", status: \"started\", est_cost: 0.03 }
GET /v1/simulate/run/r-987 -> { status: \"done\", report_url: \"...\", diff_summary: [...] }

rahul: prefer `compare` semantics as default. keep `simulate` shorthand for single-snapshot runs for SDK.

sai: ok action items:
- ben: sketch API + add run costs to billing infra
- ashley: RBAC spec, default feature flag off for non-enterprise
- ella: mockups (diff + table + csv export)
- rahul: snapshot lifecycle rules and queue limits
- operations: add sim_run events to telemetry + audit integration

ops-bot: Reminder: put primary RFC in docs repo and @sdk-team for compat check.

ella: thanks, team. i'll prototype the visual language and tag ashley for review.

sai: great. planning to discuss in next eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
